title: Travel Back To Move Forward: Retrospective Exploration and Evolving for Long Horizon Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.13058v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model agents increasingly operate in long-horizon environments where early mistakes can trigger cascading failures and trap agents in dead-end trajectories. Agents must therefore be able to proactively recover from such states and turn their exploratory experience into guidance for subsequent decisions. We introduce ReTRAIL, a framework that enables agents to rewind the environment to earlier states while preserving valid progress and carrying forward knowledge learned from abandoned exploration. The environment state moves backward while the agent's knowledge continues to move forward. ReTRAIL trains a shared policy with two complementary signals: State-Anchored GRPO compares alternative continuations from revisited states to improve execution, while a branch-advancement reward guides reflection through the progress of subsequent exploration. translated_title: 回溯前行：面向长时程智能体的回顾性探索与演化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体越来越多地在长时程环境中运行，在这种环境中，早期的错误可能引发连锁式失败，使智能体陷入无法继续的死胡同轨迹。因此，智能体必须能够主动从这类状态中恢复，并将探索中获得的经验转化为后续决策的指导。我们提出了ReTRAIL，这是一个使智能体能够将环境回退至较早状态的框架，同时保留有效的进展，并携带从被放弃的探索中所学到的知识。环境状态向后回溯，而智能体的知识持续向前演化。ReTRAIL通过两种互补的信号训练共享策略：状态锚定的GRPO（State-Anchored GRPO）通过比较从重访状态出发的不同后续行动方案来改进执行能力，而分支推进奖励则通过后续探索的进展来引导反思。在四个交互式基准测试上的实验：扫雷、推箱子、ALFWorld以及
tldr: 提出ReTRAIL框架，使智能体能够将环境回退至较早状态进行回顾性探索，同时保留已学知识与有效进展，并通过状态锚定GRPO和分支推进奖励两种互补信号训练策略，帮助长时程智能体主动从死胡同轨迹中恢复。
en_tdlr: ReTRAIL enables LLM agents to rewind the environment to earlier states while carrying forward learned knowledge, trained with State-Anchored GRPO and a branch-advancement reward to proactively recover from dead-end trajectories in long-horizon tasks.
